click: a single small plastic remote control button click, close
keys: a big ring of keys jingling and shaking

cart_rattle: a metal shopping cart rolling very fast over a concrete sidewalk, its wheels rattling and clattering, no music
sliding_door: large automatic sliding glass doors of a big store opening fast: a pneumatic hiss and a rumble, no chime, no music
box_crash: a shopping cart crashing into a tall stack of cardboard boxes, the boxes tumbling and thudding to the floor, no music
